title: Sometimes the Answer Is Not Yet
core_idea: Intuition does not always say yes or no; sometimes its honest answer is 'not yet', and waiting can be a wise choice rather than a failure.
text: We tend to expect intuition to speak in clear answers. Yes, take the job. No, don't make that call. But sometimes, when you get quiet and really listen, the answer is neither. It is simply: not yet. That can feel frustrating, especially when everyone around you wants a decision. Yet waiting is not the same as avoiding. A seed spends weeks in the dark before anything shows above the soil, and nothing is wrong with it. If you sense a gentle pause inside you, perhaps you can honor it. Give the question a little more time. Clarity often arrives on its own schedule, not on ours.
description: A gentle reflection on the times when intuition answers neither yes nor no, but simply: not yet.
